items.title: Integrate ChatGPT in Notion: A Step-by-Step Guide
items.description: Mar 20, 2024 — Learn how to integrate ChatGPT in Notion using browser extensions or Notion's AI features to boost productivity and streamline workflows.
highlighted: Learn how to integrate ChatGPT in Notion

items.markdown:
You can connect ChatGPT and Notion `using browser extensions, native integrations, or AI agent bridges` depending on whether you want to save chats or let AI read and write to your workspace.

### 1. Save ChatGPT Conversations to Notion (Browser Extensions)

- **Chat to Notion:** Install the [Chat to Notion Chrome Extension](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/chat-to-notion/oojndninaelbpllebamcojkdecjjhcle) to add a pin icon under ChatGPT answers to save specific responses or entire chats directly into any Notion database.[[1]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/chat-to-notion/oojndninaelbpllebamcojkdecjjhcle)
- **Save ChatGPT to Notion:** Use the [Save ChatGPT to Notion Chrome Extension](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/save-chatgpt-to-notion/bknieejaaomeegoflpgcckagimnbbgdp?hl=en) to export full conversations, code, and tables with one click.[[1]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/save-chatgpt-to-notion/bknieejaaomeegoflpgcckagimnbbgdp)

### 2. Connect ChatGPT Directly to Notion (Official & Agent Features)

- **ChatGPT App for Notion:** Open ChatGPT settings and connect your account via the [OpenAI Help Center Guide](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF1xBjKgPmUW3lQg8PcGLIP_5L_iZ2LochAwD19mKNYWnHXFEozz7sMC4cBhZczq-ztRpmVzI-Ma_-1r_5Y-FKT_fizwfQMfUstF5Wz--kiOtMCUfosnaTHl_MBIti2IJT_pJffBOeViB7b101nXQqfxwNnpR5eUgeBsjqF37AcjQ_0Z7hsg) to let ChatGPT search, summarize, or query authorized Notion content directly.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF1xBjKgPmUW3lQg8PcGLIP_5L_iZ2LochAwD19mKNYWnHXFEozz7sMC4cBhZczq-ztRpmVzI-Ma_-1r_5Y-FKT_fizwfQMfUstF5Wz--kiOtMCUfosnaTHl_MBIti2IJT_pJffBOeViB7b101nXQqfxwNnpR5eUgeBsjqF37AcjQ_0Z7hsg)
- **Use ChatGPT Plan with Notion Agent:** If you have a Notion Business or Enterprise plan and a ChatGPT Plus/Pro account, connect them in your workspace settings via the [Notion Help Guide](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF13P653HaaG5uzJ42nTpupIJzcAF5Y2jH6IllUAYvl3yLbvxheoHhxg1ZEnLn6petLOGKJ0Hz8xLi4QhA4sER6EVGHqnplAyjZLabbPt0OY6OqjILTuF-gA2sOLWGU0tF_gB1ayqJ1Qqc7a3W0gFmZn6TUzhN6SHMGNyywQ) to use your ChatGPT model inside Notion.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF13P653HaaG5uzJ42nTpupIJzcAF5Y2jH6IllUAYvl3yLbvxheoHhxg1ZEnLn6petLOGKJ0Hz8xLi4QhA4sER6EVGHqnplAyjZLabbPt0OY6OqjILTuF-gA2sOLWGU0tF_gB1ayqJ1Qqc7a3W0gFmZn6TUzhN6SHMGNyywQ)
- **Notion MCP:** Use [Notion MCP](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXXne8zCispEpwXA8D2NMth7fC465jABMKcV8EoRmmMs5RNV3MTGtX-xioYjalbfBfS_zn0huV0cQa0A9kTWaqJps-qLLOvlKQgz-BsaOZhLv-Vsu9hZJF2TXfWloIyCA) to create real-time bridges allowing AI assistants to read from and write to your Notion pages.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXXne8zCispEpwXA8D2NMth7fC465jABMKcV8EoRmmMs5RNV3MTGtX-xioYjalbfBfS_zn0huV0cQa0A9kTWaqJps-qLLOvlKQgz-BsaOZhLv-Vsu9hZJF2TXfWloIyCA)

### 3. Automate Workflows (Third-Party Connectors)

- **Zapier or Make:** Many users build automated pipelines via [Zapier Notion Integrations](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXX0Aq5-zOI5t7Kmc6fHIPvBT5KXdQtmq_6rHU-lokVHpoUQ3oWvxyPpBS8qtELmIIeW3xnjRMagG099h3wwtgIORTUnhxUaWSytDEJmxFA-h7-6Lod0JJDSCLNhGelrZpMTfoSWWFu7tg3ekE) or custom webhook flows to send prompts, summaries, and tasks back and forth.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF15hsmUaoR3jtiSIAbqxnF496yHkt0nN-Jri5bkviCJ_nVZvk4bQVZNAdmnL-vis558iNxn2G8JgjrrC38KbVNwUAYm_LC1X3Px_sSK953uzVPXT_1ohTo6UNyFQcy7r9tSbCJPBE50tlN9Wt0_aMPp2xR1gCmvpTb2VDkoNU2--S4KVX7wXm88nXGIm8f2vTpH9iqqdYZvCTHDB5)

If you want a specific setup, tell me:

- Do you want to **save chat history** into Notion, or let ChatGPT **read and edit** your Notion pages?
- Are you using a **free, Plus, or Business** account?
